name: Man And Wife In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that earthly institutions such as marriage do not continue in the resurrection, where believers will be like the angels of God in heaven, no longer marrying or being given in marriage (Matthew 22:30). Though our physical bodies may perish, as Job affirms, we will see God in our flesh after awakening (Job 19:26). Jesus promises to prepare a place for His followers so that they may be with Him eternally (John 14:3), and the vision of a new heaven and new earth assures believers of a transformed eternal dwelling (Revelation 21:1). Endurance in faith amid trials is essential, as salvation is promised to those who persevere until the end (Mark 13:13).
